$comment: Dependency advisories accepted with an expiry. Judged by scripts/verify-audit.mjs, which is the second half of gate 15. THIS IS NOT AN IGNORE LIST: an entry expires by itself, and an entry that no longer matches a reported advisory fails the build as stale. Adding one requires a reachability argument of at least 80 characters, a named owner, and an ADR. Read docs/adr/0059 before you add anything.

accepted.title: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
accepted.reachability: image-size is reached only through metro, the React Native bundler, which runs at BUILD time and is never in the shipped bundle — an APK contains metro's output, not metro. Triggering the loop needs a crafted ICNS file to be parsed as a bundled asset, and apps/mobile/assets holds exactly one file, NotoSansJP-Subset.ttf, with no images at all. Anyone able to add a malicious image to this repository already has write access and better options than hanging a build. The worst outcome is a CI runner that stalls until its 30-minute timeout; the exposure to a person holding the app is nil, because this code is not in it.
accepted.removeWhen: image-size publishes a release outside the advisory range, or metro stops depending on it. Neither needs watching: this gate fails the entry as STALE the moment the advisory stops being reported.

accepted.title: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
accepted.reachability: The same package, the same build-time-only path through metro, and the same absence of any image asset in this repository — JXL and HEIF rather than ICNS. It is listed separately rather than folded into the entry above because the register is keyed by advisory: one entry per GHSA is what makes a stale entry detectable, and an entry that quietly covered 'whatever else turns up in image-size' would be the blanket exemption this mechanism exists to prevent.
accepted.removeWhen: image-size publishes a release outside the advisory range, or metro stops depending on it. Neither needs watching: this gate fails the entry as STALE the moment the advisory stops being reported.
